article.title: Students Shut Down French High Schools in the Face of Class and Racial Oppression
article.author: Kevin B. Anderson
article.content: A new challenge from the left, and from the youngest of the youth, has been hurled at a racialized capitalist system which in France, as in so many other places, is moving in the direction of outright neofascism. The post Students Shut Down French High Schools in the Face of Class and Racial Oppression appeared first on MR Online .
